approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: Preserve current visible HTML text both before and after a blockquote while keeping the blockquote itself historical context.
Reuse Python HTMLParser and the existing email-history splitter; add no HTML renderer, dependency, model call or remote fetch.
title: HTML email quote boundary accuracy
objective: Prevent current HTML email text after a closed blockquote from being mislabeled as quoted history while preserving the quote as non-current evidence.
